name: Torrelles de Foix (Spain)
description: Light blue field with two black open towers and three white eight-pointed stars in the upper half of the first vertical third.
history: The flag was approved on 3 July 1997; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, light blue, with two black open towers each 7/28 of the height and 1/21 of the length, separated by a space of the same thickness, and three white eight-pointed stars of diameter 1/21 of the length, the whole centred on the first vertical third and the upper half of the cloth (arms approved 15 September 1992).

features.role: two open towers, 7/28 of the height, separated by a space of their own width
three stars, one between and two above the towers
